description: Singapore's new-company delta and company archive from ACRA open data (data.gov.sg): every Local Company, LLP and foreign-company branch on the register, the latest month's new-registrations cohort, and derived SSIC / postal-district analytics. Sole proprietorships and partnerships are excluded by design (their names are often individuals). Independent tool; not affiliated with ACRA or GovTech.
name: acra-new-companies-delta
title: ACRA New Companies Delta — Singapore Company Registrations & SSIC Analytics
